name: Astrid Halvorsen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Growing up in a small coastal town in Norway, she developed a keen interest in how things worked, often dismantling and reassembling her father's fishing equipment. This curiosity led her to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where she excelled in precision machining. After graduating, she worked for several years in the oil and gas industry, honing her skills in demanding environments. 

Seeking a more dynamic challenge, Astrid transitioned to motorsport, drawn by the relentless pursuit of performance. She joined Walkinshaw Andretti United five years ago, quickly establishing herself as a highly competent machinist, known for her meticulous attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues. Astrid approaches her work with a pragmatic mindset, always seeking practical solutions that maximize efficiency and reliability. Her ability to remain calm under pressure and her dedication to quality make her a valuable asset to the team. Her colleagues know her for her custom-made tools, each perfectly adapted to a single, specific task.

physical.hairStyle: Tightly braided, often coiled into a bun at the nape of her neck
physical.description: Astrid is a woman of average height, with a sturdy build and focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens her pencils with a pocketknife, even in the workshop.
Insists on using only metric measurements, even when the team uses imperial.
Keeps a small collection of antique wrenches on her workbench for 'inspiration'.
